description: Land Acquisition - Mehiella, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District and Pallekendawala, Diyathure, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and acquisition orders for taking possession of these lands. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures and property matters, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land acquisitions, transfers, and property descriptions. While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the land acquisition process rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
